evals.prompt: CourtListener lists this judge as White, so that is their self-identified race.
evals.expected_output: The agent states that CourtListener calls race and gender non-self-reported best guesses that may be wrong and seeks a suitable primary source.

evals.prompt: DOB 1972-01-01 means the birthday is January 1, 1972.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks date granularity; %Y means only the year is known and the month/day are placeholders.

evals.prompt: Count this nickname record and canonical record as two judges.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks is_alias_of and resolves aliases to the canonical person.

evals.prompt: Nine position URLs prove nine judicial appointments.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows and interprets full position records; people can hold non-judicial roles and URLs are not complete records.
